name: Sendd MCP
description:
The Sendd MCP server connects Claude directly to your Sendd storefront and marketplace, so you can run your commerce operations conversationally without switching tabs.
Product management: create and update physical products, digital downloads, subscriptions, rentals, events, menu items, flexible-price ("pay what you want") products, link products, and enquiry forms. Publish listings live, archive them, or restore them anytime.
Catalog organization: build and manage categories and collections, add or remove listings from each, and keep your storefront structured as it grows.
Orders and fulfilment: list and inspect orders, update order status, and edit customer or shipping details on any order.
Customers and subscribers: view your customer base aggregated from paid orders, and manage subscription customers by plan, status, and billing period.
Discounts: create, update, and manage coupons with flexible discount terms and restrictions.
Events and ticketing: sell tickets, list and export attendees, issue complimentary tickets, resend confirmations with QR codes and wallet passes, refund purchases, and pull ticket-sales analytics.
Insights: get sales summaries across any date range, including total revenue and order counts, plus low-stock inventory reports across products, menu items, and rental locations.
Works seamlessly across both Sendd Store (free storefronts) and Sendd Market (marketplace-as-a-service), giving curators and merchants a single conversational interface to their entire operation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sendd MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sendd MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://sendd.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sendd MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sendd MCP lists 58 MCP tools, including add_category_items, add_collection_items, create_category, create_collection, create_coupon, create_digital_product, create_enquiry, create_event, create_flexible_price_product, create_link_product, create_menu_item, and create_product.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sendd MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sendd MCP in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Sendd MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sendd MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sendd MCP is developed by Sendd, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
